N-cone.objects: Real Banach A0,A1; cone M+ and gauge; family F of A0-valued trajectories.
N-cone.domain: Fixed finite (0,T); 1<=p,q<=infinity in the stated allowed pairs.
N-cone.fixed_and_variable: All spaces, injection and gauge fixed; v varies over F.
N-cone.hypotheses: Degree-one positive definite gauge, nonnegative scaling, continuous gauge embedding and compact gauge-bounded sequences; a.e. membership and both measurabilities; A1 distributional derivative bound.
N-cone.equations: Gauge axioms, embedding norm inequality and combined uniform time/gauge bound are explicit.
N-cone.quantifiers: Constants uniform in v; q>1 or q=1 with finite p.
N-cone.conclusion: Relative compactness in Lp(A0); no claim that limits lie in an unclosed cone.
N-cone.status: Established source theorem, with a separate local proof avoiding a flagged source passage.
N-cone.local_definitions: The nonnegative cone and gauge are fully repeated inside this principal.

scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Compared the full statement with source Theorem 1 and Remark 2, pp. 3--4. No closed-cone conclusion is asserted.
